title: A profile of former Google DeepMind employee Thibault Sottiaux, now OpenAI's head of core products tasked with combining ChatGPT and Codex into a super app (Maxwell Zeff/Wired)
summary: Maxwell Zeff / Wired: A profile of former Google DeepMind employee Thibault Sottiaux, now OpenAI's head of core products tasked with combining ChatGPT and Codex into a super app — Thibault Sottiaux helped make AI coding one of OpenAI's fastest-growing businesses. Now he's overseeing a sweeping overhaul of ChatGPT.
